answer: Payment sits in escrow until grading closes, and a replay of an existing submission claws the full amount back, so copying earns negative. No identity audits its own recruit, so a referral chain cannot grade itself. Budget line: 1,000 clones need 1,000 escrowed jobs finished and 1,000 independent auditors before a single coin clears. That is a glacier of working capital for a quartz of payout, which is why a farm looks for a cheaper haven and finds none.
